reuse: ⚠️ This week's Publix deal fetch FAILED, so this plan is not built around the weekly ad. Deals may exist; I just couldn't see them. Check the ad in-store, especially for the chicken thighs, sirloin and ground turkey. Monday roasts ALL 5 lb of chicken thighs, and the plain 2 lb pan becomes Tuesday's lemon chicken orzo soup, so Tuesday has no raw meat. Wednesday cooks a double pot of brown rice, and half becomes Thursday's cilantro-lime rice for the turkey taco bowls. Carrots and lemons are split Mon/Tue. Bell peppers are split Mon/Thu. Scallions and cilantro are split Wed/Thu. Yellow onion is split Tue/Thu. Garlic is used Mon/Tue/Wed.

dinners.name: Sheet Pan Italian Chicken Thighs with Zucchini, Carrots & Peppers
dinners.blurb: Boneless thighs and a lot of vegetables in a herby red wine vinegar marinade, roasted hot at 450°F until the edges char. Finished with parsley and lemon.
dinners.warn: COOK ONCE, EAT TWICE: roast ALL 5 lb of thighs. The plain 2-lb pan is Tuesday's soup. Cool it, then refrigerate it covered. Don't eat it tonight.
dinners.alt: Roasted Italian-seasoned chicken thighs with zucchini, carrots, red and yellow peppers and red onion on a sheet pan

ingredients.group: Marinade (recipe scaled 2.5x, enough for all the chicken)

items: 5 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, trimmed (3 lb for tonight, 2 lb for Tuesday)
1 1/4 tsp kosher salt, for the chicken
3 medium zucchini (~1.5 lb), cut into 1-inch pieces
2 red + 2 yellow bell peppers, cut into 1-inch pieces
Chopped parsley and lemon wedges to finish

directions: Whisk the marinade in your biggest bowl. Salt all 5 lb of chicken and toss it in the marinade. Let it sit 30 min (or up to overnight, refrigerated). While it sits, cut the vegetables.
Heat the oven to 450°F with racks in the center and lower third. Line or spray THREE sheet pans.

TUESDAY'S PAN: put 2 lb of the chicken (about 8 thighs) alone on one pan, in a single layer. Roast it on the center rack for about 20 min, until it reaches 165°F. Set it aside to cool. This pan is for Tuesday.

Toss the vegetables in the marinade left in the bowl. Spread the remaining 3 lb of chicken and all the vegetables over the other two pans in a single layer, with nothing touching, so they roast instead of steaming.
Roast both pans for 20 min. Flip the chicken and vegetables, swap the pans between racks, and roast about 10 min more, until the chicken hits 165°F and the vegetables are browned at the edges.
Shower with parsley and squeeze lemon over the top. Serve.
Before bed, refrigerate Tuesday's cooled chicken whole in a covered container. Don't shred it yet.
dinners.reuse: Hands Tuesday 2 lb of roasted thighs for the soup. Shares carrots, lemon and parsley with Tue, and bell peppers with Thu.

dinners.name: Lemon Chicken Orzo Soup with Spinach & Dill
dinners.blurb: A bright, lemony soup with carrots, celery, whole wheat orzo and spinach, made fast with Monday's roasted chicken. Crusty bread on the side.
dinners.warn: No raw meat tonight: use the 2 lb of thighs Monday roasted.
dinners.alt: Bowl of lemon chicken orzo soup with carrots, spinach and fresh dill

items: 3/4 tsp kosher salt + 1/2 tsp black pepper
Monday's 2 lb roasted chicken thighs, diced or shredded
3 Tbsp chopped fresh dill + a handful of chopped parsley

directions: Warm the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the carrots, celery, onion, basil, salt and pepper. Cook about 8 min, until they soften and just start to brown.
Add the garlic and stir 30 seconds. Sprinkle in the flour and stir until it disappears. Pour in 9 cups of broth and bring it to a boil.
While it heats, dice or shred Monday's chicken.
Stir the orzo into the boiling broth. Lower to a simmer and cook about 7 min, stirring now and then, until the orzo is VERY al dente. It keeps softening in the hot soup.
Add the chicken, spinach, lemon juice, dill and parsley. Simmer 3-5 min, until the spinach wilts and the chicken is hot. Thin with the remaining broth if you want it soupier.
Taste for salt and lemon, since it usually wants a little more of each. Serve with the warm bread.
Leftovers thicken as the orzo drinks the broth. Loosen them with a splash of broth or water when you reheat.
dinners.reuse: Built on Monday's roasted chicken. Uses the rest of the carrots, lemons and parsley, and the first of the yellow onions (the rest go to Thu).

dinners.name: Broccoli Beef Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
dinners.blurb: Thin-sliced sirloin and crisp-tender broccoli in a glossy soy-garlic-ginger sauce over brown rice. Better than takeout, with half the sugar.
dinners.warn: COOK ONCE, EAT TWICE: cook ALL 3 cups of dry brown rice. Half is Thursday's cilantro-lime rice. Spread the leftovers on a plate to cool, then refrigerate.
dinners.alt: Broccoli beef stir-fry in a skillet with sesame seeds

ingredients.group: Sauce (2x; brown sugar cut from 1/2 cup to 1/3 cup)

items: 2 lb beef sirloin, sliced thin against the grain
2 large heads broccoli, cut into small florets
Red pepper flakes, sesame seeds and cilantro for the table (heat goes on the side)
3 cups dry brown rice (makes ~9 cups; half is Thursday's)

directions: Start the rice first: all 3 cups of brown rice, stovetop or rice cooker, ~45 min hands-off.

Sauce: whisk the soy sauce, water and brown sugar. In a small saucepan, warm 2 Tbsp oil and cook the garlic and ginger until fragrant (~30 sec). Add the soy mixture, bring it to a boil, then simmer on low 5 min. Set it aside.
Toss the sliced beef with the sesame oil and 2 tsp of the cornstarch. Let it sit 10 min while you cut the broccoli into small florets and slice the scallions.

Heat 1 Tbsp oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the beef in TWO batches, ~2 min each, until just cooked, adding another 1 Tbsp oil for the second batch. Move it to a plate. Crowding steams the beef, so don't skip the batches.
Whisk the remaining 2 tsp cornstarch into the sauce.
Add the last 2 Tbsp oil to the pan, then the broccoli and 6 Tbsp water. Stir-fry ~4 min, until crisp-tender and bright green.
Return the beef and its juices, pour in the sauce and stir over low heat ~1 min until glossy. Add the salt and most of the scallions (save a handful for Thursday). Taste and adjust.
Serve over rice with pepper flakes, sesame seeds and cilantro at the table. Cool the leftover rice and refrigerate it for Thursday.
dinners.reuse: Makes Thursday's rice. Shares scallions and cilantro with Thu, and garlic with Mon/Tue.

dinners.name: Turkey Taco Lettuce Wraps & Cilantro-Lime Rice Bowls
dinners.blurb: Juicy, well-spiced turkey taco meat simmered in tomato sauce. Pile it into crisp lettuce cups or onto cilantro-lime rice with fresh pico, avocado, cheddar and yogurt. Flour tortillas for anyone who wants a taco.
dinners.warn: Uses Wednesday's leftover brown rice. No beans, no corn: the tortillas are FLOUR.
dinners.alt: Ground turkey taco meat in iceberg lettuce cups with cheese and tomato

items: 2.5 lb 93% lean ground turkey (the recipe uses 99%; 93% stays juicier)
1 bell pepper, minced (more veg than the recipe's 2 Tbsp)
Wednesday's leftover brown rice (~4 cups) + juice of 1 lime + 1/4 cup chopped cilantro + salt
Quick pico: 4 Roma tomatoes (diced), 1/2 yellow onion (minced), 1/3 cup cilantro, juice of 1 lime, salt
Leaves from 2 heads iceberg (or 3 romaine hearts)
Plain Greek yogurt in place of sour cream
Flour tortillas, warmed; jalapeño, hot sauce and lime wedges on the side

directions: Brown the turkey in your largest skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it into small crumbles, ~8 min, until no longer pink.

Stir in the garlic powder, cumin, salt, chili powder, paprika and oregano. Add the onion, bell pepper, water and tomato sauce. Cover and simmer on low ~20 min, then uncover for the last few minutes if it's soupy.
While it simmers, make the pico: toss the tomatoes, onion, cilantro, lime juice and salt.
Reheat Wednesday's rice (microwave with a splash of water, covered). Toss it with lime juice, cilantro and salt.
Separate, wash and dry the lettuce leaves. Slice the avocado and warm the tortillas.
Set everything out. Everyone builds their own lettuce wraps, a rice bowl or tacos. Jalapeño and hot sauce stay on the side.
dinners.reuse: Finishes Wednesday's rice, scallions and cilantro. Uses the last bell pepper from Mon's bag and the last yellow onion from Tue.
